pair.title: Add Dru fireplace
pair.nosettings: Please fill in all the required fields.
pair.intro: Enter the IP address and port of your Dru gateway. The gateway accepts one connection at a time, so remove other integrations (such as older Homey Dru apps) first.

error.locked: Unlock ignition first, or use the slide on the Fireplace widget

widget.slide: Slide up and hold 2 seconds to ignite
